question: The value of M in ((p)/(q))²M⁺² = ((q)/(p))⁹⁻M
solution:
**Given:**

The equation is:

(p/q)²M⁺² = (q/p)⁹⁻M

**Formula used:**

Using the property of exponents:

am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ and a⁻ⁿ = 1/aⁿ

**Calculation:**

(p/q)²M⁺² = (q/p)⁹⁻M

⇒ (p/q)²M⁺² = (p/q)⁻⁽⁹⁻M⁾

⇒ 2M + 2 = -(9 - M)

⇒ 2M + 2 = -9 + M

⇒ 2M - M = -9 - 2

⇒ M = -11

**∴ The value of M is -11.**
